conditions.preparation: Festuca arundinacea garden grass, shredded 0.5-2 mm; cow manure and yeast-factory anaerobic sludge

sources.limitation: No verified mono-digestion BMP for arbitrary grass. TS/VS table basis requires further checking; mixture yield is not a grass property.

dossiers.loading_limit_note: No universal safe OLR established. Study-specific loading, ISR and duration belong to their original reactor and feeding regime.
dossiers.co_digestion: No universal synergy or compatible mixing ratio inferred; compare specific mixed-substrate studies before transfer.
